description: A toy kitchen counter sits in front of a tall gray fridge beside a small oven, with a burger, a roll, a dark plum, a banana, and a green pear on the countertop. The left hand reaches up to the fridge handle and swings the door open toward the viewer while the right hand, one item at a time, picks up the roll and places it on the upper shelf, then places the burger beside it, sets the plum in the lower compartment, lays the banana down, and finally places the pear near the banana before the left hand swings the fridge door closed.
